mapper.select: SELECT provider_type AS platformType, external_store_id AS externalStoreId, store_name AS storeName, enabled FROM external_stores WHERE provider_type = #{platformType} AND enabled = 1 ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT provider_type AS platformType, external_store_id AS externalStoreId, external_menu_id AS externalMenuId, catalog_key AS catalogKey, menu_name AS menuName, price, enabled FROM external_menus WHERE provider_type = #{platformType} AND external_store_id = #{externalStoreId} AND enabled = 1 ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC
